description: Performance Prediction Model - Enhanced pass probability estimation using accuracy trends, coverage completeness, time consistency, and per-subject weighted scoring. Builds on existing readiness-calculator.ts to provide a detailed 'You have X% chance of passing' prediction with actionable recommendations on what to focus on to improve.
steps: Create src/features/performance-prediction/ directory with types/, utils/, components/, and __tests__/ subdirectories

Create src/features/performance-prediction/types/index.ts with interfaces: PredictionResult (passProb, confidence interval, trend direction, projectedExamDate), PredictionFactor (name, score, weight, impact description), FocusRecommendation (subject, topic, priority, expectedImpact, reason)

Create src/features/performance-prediction/utils/prediction-engine.ts implementing: (1) computePassProbability() using weighted factors: accuracy (40%), coverage (20%), consistency/trend (20%), time management (10%), confidence calibration (10%), (2) computeTrend() analyzing last 7/14/30 day accuracy changes, (3) computeConsistency() measuring variance in daily scores

Create src/features/performance-prediction/utils/focus-recommender.ts that identifies the top 5 areas to focus on by computing expected score improvement per hour of study for each subject/topic combination, weighing CFA curriculum weights, current weakness, and available question count
Create src/features/performance-prediction/utils/prediction-storage.ts to cache daily prediction snapshots in localStorage (key: 'cfa-buddy-predictions'), keeping last 90 days for trend visualization

Create src/features/performance-prediction/components/prediction-dashboard.tsx - client component displaying: (1) large pass probability gauge/circle, (2) factor breakdown showing each input's contribution, (3) trend line over time, (4) top-5 focus recommendations with expected impact
Create src/features/performance-prediction/components/focus-plan.tsx - renders the prioritized study plan as a card list with subject, topic, time estimate, and expected score improvement

Create src/features/performance-prediction/__tests__/prediction-engine.test.ts testing: (1) zero attempts returns 0% probability, (2) high accuracy + coverage gives > 70%, (3) high accuracy but low coverage is penalized, (4) declining trend reduces probability, (5) consistent high performer gets > 85%

Create src/features/performance-prediction/__tests__/focus-recommender.test.ts testing: (1) recommends lowest-accuracy high-weight subjects first, (2) limits to 5 recommendations, (3) handles no data gracefully, (4) curriculum weights affect priority order
Add route page at src/app/(protected)/insights/prediction/page.tsx that renders the prediction dashboard
Link the prediction from the main Insights page (src/app/(protected)/insights/page.tsx) with a prominent card/CTA
acceptance_criteria: Running npm run test passes all new tests
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
Prediction engine produces sensible probability estimates (0-100%) based on practice data
Focus recommender prioritizes high-curriculum-weight weak subjects
Trend analysis correctly identifies improving vs declining performance
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
